_readme: Reviewed npm advisories that CI tolerates TEMPORARILY (approved by the product owner). One entry per advisory id. Every entry needs a reason (why it can't hurt us) and an expiry date (max ~30 days); after it, CI fails again so the advisory is re-checked. Never add an advisory that affects code shipped to browsers. See scripts/audit-check.mjs.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS via attacker-supplied extglob patterns. picomatch is only used by build/test tools (vite, vitest via tinyglobby/fdir) with our own fixed patterns; it is not shipped to browsers and never receives untrusted input. No patched version exists yet (<= 4.0.7 affected, 4.0.7 is latest).
